text_block_list.text:
From the other side, Winning Ticket was 
walking over, looking unusually 
downcast...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Trainer-san! Listen to this, come 
ooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I went to that popular sweet 
shop everyone's talking about. And yet! 
And yet, can you believe it?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They dold oud righd in frond of my 
eyeees~~~~~~!!
choice_data_list: You really wanted to eat it that badly...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Of course I wanted to eat it, but what 
really hurts is that it sold out right in 
front of me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because, if I waited in line for an hour 
and didn't get to eat, the shock would be 
way too devastating...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Why didn't I line up earlier...? I'm such 
an idiot, idiot, idiotttttt!!"

Winning Ticket's sorrowful scream echoed 
through the town...
